name: India Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP Act 2023 / CERT-In)
description: Compliance framework for India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 (DPDP Act), Information Technology Act 2000, IT Intermediary Rules 2021, and CERT-In 6-hour cybersecurity incident reporting directions.
owner: India Data Protection & Cyber Governance Office

checklists.name: India DPDP Act & CERT-In Compliance Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for DPDP Act 2023 sections, IT Act 2000, and CERT-In directions.

items.statement: Consent notices present itemized data processing details in English and Schedule 8 Indian languages (DPDP Sec 5).
Data Principal consent withdrawal mechanisms are as easy as giving consent (DPDP Sec 6).
Cybersecurity incidents (ransomware, data breaches, unauthorized access) are reported to CERT-In within 6 hours.
System clocks across all ICT infrastructure are synchronized with National Physical Laboratory (NPL) NTP time servers.
System logs are maintained immutably for a rolling period of 180 days within Indian jurisdiction.

reviewGates.name: India DPDP Act & CERT-In Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Data Protection Officer and CISO confirm that DPDP consent flows, 180-day log retention, and CERT-In incident escalation satisfy Indian law.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the compliance review confirm full alignment with DPDP Act 2023 and CERT-In directions?
